title: QuickBooks Online Pricing 2026: Plans and Costs
summary: QuickBooks Online pricing ranges across four plans with different features. Compare what each tier costs to find the best fit for your accounting needs.
body_markdown:
## Cut manual entry costs around QuickBooks with Activepieces


What QuickBooks charges you stays the same with Activepieces, a workflow automation tool with 746 integrations that connects apps without custom programming. It can remove the typing that makes you hire or stretch staff to keep up.


A person re-keying invoices and orders is a cost your plan comparison never shows, and it grows with every order, which is why it belongs next to your seat count.


### Where QuickBooks automation saves money


Look at who touches QuickBooks today. If one person copies customer orders from email into invoices, or retypes web form submissions into the books, that person's hours are the cost.


So are the typos that surface later as a wrong invoice or an awkward call to a customer. Doing nothing means paying for that time indefinitely.


When the work is repetitive and the inputs look alike each time, automation helps most. It helps least when every order is a one-off needing judgment.


It also doesn't shrink your user count. The flow runs under one connection, so you still decide who needs a seat and who only needs their work to arrive in the books already entered.


### What the QuickBooks integration can do


Activepieces has a QuickBooks integration, one of those 746 and part of the roughly 60% contributed by the community, available as an integration you can use as a tool in a flow, so you can build QuickBooks workflows immediately.


The diagram shows the shape of it.


A form submission and an order email both feed an Activepieces flow, which uses the QuickBooks integration as a tool, and a person reviews the result before anything goes out.


The free plan's 1,000 credits a month and unlimited flows are enough to run this as a trial before it touches your budget.


That review step is deliberate. Let the flow do the typing and keep a human on the approval, so a bad input gets caught once rather than copied into your books.


What follows is checking the limits. Intuit publishes API rules on its developer pages, and those govern how much a connected tool can send and how often.


Read them before you build around a high volume, and confirm that the specific actions you need are supported in your setup.
